structured.answer: My answer: there's a long list of stuff the site can't calculate yet, all tagged "לא מחושב": gold funds (השקעה בזהב דרך קרנות סל, ETC), אג"ח, foreign-currency stuff (פיקדון מט"ח, צמוד דולר, מנוטרלת מט"ח, עמלת חליפין), structured deposits, REITs, a digital investment portfolio, and a pile of insurance and pension things. Below that it says it never does loans, picking stocks, ranking funds by past returns ("דירוג לפי תשואה בעבר"), or buying for you. My plain index-fund thing isn't on the list, so I guess that part is covered. But it won't tell me which fund went up most, and that's how I'd usually pick.

stuck.why: "החוקים והכללים לכל המוצרים כאן עוד בבדיקה": does that mean the info under each card is wrong, or just not done yet? It made me trust the cards less
